description: RM-X: adds jack control of Ramelig's jump and shift actions and a way to hand it a note from outside; it goes directly to the left or right of a Ramelig module

inputs.text: Forces the next trigger to jump, on each rise to 1V, as the jump button on Ramelig does
Forces the next trigger to shift to a new centre, on each rise to 1V, as the shift button on Ramelig does
The pitch Ramelig uses instead of generating one, whenever the guide gate is high at the next trigger; it is folded into the range limits and quantized to the scale in use
Makes Ramelig take its note from the guide pitch instead of generating one, while it is at 1V or above

outputs.text: A short gate each time Ramelig actually performs a jump, however that jump was chosen
A short gate each time Ramelig actually performs a shift, however that shift was chosen

notes: this module is placed directly to the left or right of a Ramelig module, and runs in the same polyphonic mode the Ramelig module is in
a forced action produces nothing at the outputs until the next trigger on the Ramelig module actually performs it
a guided note becomes the note Ramelig carries on from at the following trigger
